# Third-party 3D assets (Greybox 3D view)

All assets below were downloaded from their official pages on 2026-11-22 and are
**CC0 1.0 (public domain)**. No paid, CC-BY-NC, or ripped assets are included.
Only the files actually used by this proto were copied into this folder.

## Quaternius — Ultimate Animated Character Pack (November 2019)

- Author: Quaternius
- Official pack page: https://quaternius.com/packs/ultimatedanimatedcharacter.html
- Official OGA mirror (explicit CC0): https://opengameart.org/content/animated-characters-pack
- License page / deed: https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/
- License: **CC0 1.0**. Pack page: “free to use in personal and commercial projects.”
  OGA listing: “License(s): CC0”. (Later Quaternius packs may use QAL; this 2019 pack is CC0 and is not covered retroactively by QAL.)
- Files used: `Cowboy_Male.fbx` (idle, walk, shoot, hit, punch clips).
- Recolor: hero (purple hat/shirt, red scarf, blue jeans) and grunt (brown hat, tan shirt, red scarf, blue jeans) at runtime. No third-party textures were modified on disk.

## Kenney — Nature Kit (2.1)

- Author: Kenney (www.kenney.nl)
- Official page: https://kenney.nl/assets/nature-kit
- License on page: Creative Commons CC0 — https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/
- Included `License.txt` states CC0, free for personal, educational and commercial projects.
- Files used (FBX only; these models are vertex-colored): cactus_short/tall, grass, grass_large, grass_leafs, rock_smallA/B/C, rock_tallA/B, rock_largeA, cliff_block_rock, cliff_large_rock, cliff_top_rock.

## Lucian Pavel — Low poly CC0: Western Objects Pack

- Author: Lucian Pavel
- Official page: https://opengameart.org/content/low-poly-cc0-western-objects-pack
- License on page: **CC0**
- Files used: `LowPolyWesternObjects.fbx` (crates, barrels, cactus, fence, etc.) and wood / dirt / fabric / vegetation / concrete / metal textures for storefronts and ground.

Credit is not required under CC0; names and URLs are recorded here for provenance.

## Kenney — Mini Characters (2.0)

- Author: Kenney (www.kenney.nl)
- Official page: https://kenney.nl/assets/mini-characters
- Author upload (used for the 2.0 zip): https://opengameart.org/content/mini-character-1
- Direct zip: https://opengameart.org/sites/default/files/kenney_mini-characters_2.0.zip
- License on page and in included `License.txt`: **Creative Commons CC0 1.0**
  https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/
- Downloaded 2026-11-23. Only the files used by this proto were copied into
  `ThirdParty/KenneyMiniCharacters/`.
- Files used: `character-male-g.fbx` (hero), `character-raider.fbx` (grunt),
  `weapon-shooter.fbx` (gun prop), `Textures/colormap.png`.
- In-house remaps of Kenney's CC0 colormap (still CC0, no new third-party):
  `colormap_hero.png`, `colormap_grunt.png`, `colormap_grunt_b.png`,
  `colormap_grunt_c.png`.
- Animations used from the FBX takes: idle, walk, sprint, holding-right-shoot,
  fall (hit), die, jump (available; roll uses the existing procedural spin).

Credit is not required under CC0; names and URLs are recorded here for provenance.

## Lilita One (SIL Open Font License 1.1)

- Font: Lilita One Regular
- Copyright (c) 2011 Juan Montoreano (juan@remolacha.biz), with Reserved Font Name Lilita
- License: SIL Open Font License, Version 1.1 — full text in `Assets/HillNGun/Proto/Greybox3D/Art/Fonts/OFL.txt`
- Used for 3D-view SCORE/STAGE numerals (and any TMP/UI text in the 3D HUD).
- Downloaded from the box Google Fonts collection (`/usr/share/fonts/truetype/sand-box/google/Lilita One/`).

## HILL N GUN designer 3D skins (original)

- Author: the project's designer (confirmed concept sheets + skin pack).
- Location: `Assets/HillNGun/Proto/Greybox3D/Art/{UI,FX,Characters,Environment,Fonts}/`
- These textures, sprites, and colormaps are original game art, not third-party.
- Kenney Mini Characters colormap layout is CC0 (see Mini Characters above); designer remaps and extra swatches (T*/X*, turret map) are original.

## HILL N GUN 2D chibi skin (slice J, self-made, CC0)

- Location: `Assets/HillNGun/Proto/Greybox/Art/Chibi/` (61 PNGs + `README.md`; generator scripts in `Source~/`).
- Drawn procedurally for this project (Python/PIL vector drawing). No third-party images or traced artwork.
- Dedicated to the public domain under CC0 1.0 — see `Greybox/Art/Chibi/README.md` for the sprite list, sizes and pivots.
- Sign text and the 2D chibi HUD numerals use Lilita One (SIL OFL 1.1, see the Lilita One section above).
